verdict.rationale: Adyen documents centralized terminal management in its unified Customer Area and lets you order terminals via the Management API for delivery to a location of your choice, which touches multi-site device fleets. Nothing in the evidence shows store or location entities with assigned devices, location-level settings, or reporting broken down by location. Missing for 10: explicit store/location hierarchy with per-location device assignment, per-location terminal settings configuration, per-location reporting, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can run multiple locations with per-location devices, settings, and reporting

citations.quote: Lets you manage your payment terminals and transactions from our unified Customer Area.
The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
